heading: Biomedical Ethics Board; disbursement of funds, computation and disbursement of basic pay, and provision of financial management services and support by Library of Congress
lead: Effective October 1, 1988, and to continue thereafter, the Disbursing Officer of the Library of Congress is authorized to— in the same manner as provided with respect to the Office of Technology Assessment under section 142f of this title.

tree.text: disburse funds appropriated for the Biomedical Ethics Board;
compute and disburse the basic pay for all personnel of the Biomedical Ethics Board; and
provide financial management services and support to the Biomedical Ethics Board,

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsProvisions similar to those in this section were contained in the following prior appropriation act: Pub. L. 100–458, title I, Oct. 1, 1988, 102 Stat. 2168.
